title: Core web launch certification suite
goal: Certify the exact deployed staging release SHA across every core user, authorization, commerce, realtime, accessibility, and performance journey

in: Authentication, personas, discovery, events, ticketing, marketplace, messaging, uploads, and account deletion E2E
Negative authorization, webhook replay, concurrency, accessibility, responsive browser, and performance scenarios
out: Mobile launch certification and deferred advanced music/governance capabilities

acceptance_criteria: All core launch journeys pass against the exact staging release SHA using synthetic data and Stripe test mode
Cross-role, cross-user, and cross-tenant denial scenarios pass with no accidental skips
Webhook replay, transaction concurrency, accessibility, responsive-browser, and performance gates pass
No unresolved P0/P1 defect remains and evidence is attached to the certified release SHA

2026-09-25 Wave 32 root cause: the failing 'E2E Tests (Playwright)' check on PR #14 (run 35761778422, job 106862321148) was NOT a Playwright failure. Step 7 'Build app' was cancelled after 28m38s and steps 8-11 (Start app, Wait for app, Run E2E tests, upload artifact) were all 'skipped', so zero tests executed. Annotations: 'The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 30m0s' and 'The operation was canceled.'

2026-09-25 Wave 32 mechanism: last build log line is 'Linting and checking validity of types ...' at 2026-09-22T17:43:47.5458532Z, followed by 25m31s of total silence. npm run build = 'npm run validate:env:production && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 next build', and next.config.ts sets eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds=false and typescript.ignoreBuildErrors=false, so the build runs a full-repo ESLint and a full tsc --noEmit inline. The webpack compile was only 3.0m; the job cap of 30m was consumed by the inline typecheck.

2026-09-25 Wave 32 measured cost on the identical SHA: ci.yml run 35761777731 job 106861310047 'Lint And Build' measured Lint 48s success, Typecheck 68m18s FAILURE, and skipped the Build step. Full tsc therefore needs more than twice the entire 30m E2E budget, so the PR E2E job could never reach npm run test:e2e at any result.

2026-09-25 Wave 32 non-QA blocker: the typecheck failed with 1384 TypeScript errors across 189 files (TS2339 495, TS2769 265, TS2322 180, TS2589 163, TS2345 161). Root pattern: product code queries about 110 relations and about 35 RPCs that are absent from the generated Supabase types. venue_team_contractors and venue_crew_members are defined only in supabase/migrations/archive/enhanced_staff_management_schema.sql, are not in the active chain, and have 0 occurrences in types/database.types.ts. The 'Database Types' check failed separately and earlier with 'ERROR: must be owner of table objects (SQLSTATE 42501)' while applying 20260413200000_port_missing_tables.sql. Handed to database as HF-QA-003-TYPECHECK-BLOCKER.

2026-09-25 Wave 32 local gate fix evidence: npx playwright test --list reproduced the pre-existing collection failure 'Error: Launch certification fixture invalid: QA_CERT_FIXTURE_PATH is required' with 'Total: 0 tests in 0 files' because playwright.config.ts testDir './tests/e2e' collected tests/e2e/launch-certification. After testIgnore the PR suite enumerates 'Total: 11 tests in 5 files'. The launch config still enumerates 'Total: 33 tests in 1 file'. e2e.yml parses with job timeout 115 and step caps Build app 80, Wait for app 5, Run E2E tests 25; launch-certification is unchanged at 45. npx vitest run __tests__/qa/e2e-fail-closed-gate.test.ts passed 15/15. Scoped tsc on playwright.config.ts and tests/e2e/helpers/fail-on-skipped-reporter.ts exited 0. npx eslint on all three changed files exited 0. git diff --check clean. npm run agents:validate passed 17 agents, 151 tasks, 0 warnings, 0 errors.

progress.summary: Diagnosed the PR #14 E2E failure as a build timeout, not a test failure: 'Build app' was cancelled after 28m38s and Start app/Wait for app/Run E2E tests/upload were all skipped, so zero Playwright tests ran. The gate is NOT green: next build must still fail on 1384 TS errors across 189 files, handed to database as HF-QA-003-TYPECHECK-BLOCKER.
